question: Lachhu Maharaj is a celebrated ________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lachhu Maharaj** is a celebrated **Kathak** dancer.
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of **Indian classical dance**.
 
• This dance form traces its origins to the nomadic bards of ancient northern India, known as **Kathakars** or storytellers.
 
• Kathak is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures and facial expressions, which are used to tell a story.
 
• It has three main gharanas (schools) – **Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras**, each with its own unique style and emphasis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lachhu Maharaj** (1901–1978), also known as **Baij Nath Prasad**, was a noted Kathak dancer and choreographer from the **Banaras gharana**.
 
• He was honored with the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for his contribution to Indian dance.
 
• Lachhu Maharaj was known for his expressive abhinaya (acting) and delicate footwork.
 
• He contributed significantly to the popularization and development of Kathak dance in India and abroad.
 
• His legacy continues to inspire new generations of Kathak dancers.
